subject: How LLMs Are Changing Every Job
body:
View this post on the web at https://louisbouchard.substack.com/p/how-llms-are-changing-every-job

Good morning!
Today, I’m sharing our third video out of 6 we made for our “8-hour Generative AI Primer [ https://substack.com/redirect/7817cc33-e914-462c-a608-a81180d1b4b6?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]” course.
In this one, we share an overview of the impact of LLMs on human work, which is complex and varied across different job categories...
Watch the video [ https://substack.com/redirect/5e4a39a6-4f06-4a4a-bf5d-cf76636d9c9b?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] (written article here [ https://substack.com/redirect/4d41dc51-9094-4497-b816-535918898272?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ], Spotify audio-only version here [ https://substack.com/redirect/9ede12e2-368a-4342-94d0-3161bf68c1b3?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]):
Some more info about our recent course:
In this course, we teach software professionals how to effectively integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into their workflows, products, and industries—without requiring expertise in machine learning. This course is code-agnostic, focusing on core concepts and the essential knowledge developers need to work with LLMs. You’ll gain a deep understanding of how these models function, how to evaluate and compare them, and how to leverage techniques like prompt engineering to enhance their performance. Whether you’re building AI-driven applications, automating workflows, or optimizing existing systems, we provide the skills to confidently incorporate LLMs into your projects.
Beyond the fundamentals, we introduce the key tools and methodologies for customizing and optimizing LLMs, including Retrieval Augmented Generation, fine-tuning, prompt caching, AI agents, and more. You’ll learn how to interact with leading LLMs, explore no-code agent-building platforms, and analyze real-world case studies of AI implementations that have driven significant business impact. By the end of the course, you’ll have a clear roadmap for integrating AI into your development work, along with certification and access to an exclusive community for ongoing learning and mentorship. Join us to stay ahead in the AI-driven future of software development!
And that's it for this iteration! I'm incredibly grateful that the What's AI newsletter [ https://substack.com/redirect/75a15657-5d6d-4ed1-bf0c-f9d71cd58a24?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] is now read by over 20,000 incredible human beings. Click here [ https://substack.com/redirect/323f8290-ac68-49b8-a7fd-adc4b7fcc485?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] to share this iteration with a friend if you learned something new!
Looking for more cool AI stuff? 👇
Looking for AI news, code, learning resources, papers, memes, and more? Follow our weekly newsletter at Towards AI [ https://substack.com/redirect/0ae8ea22-4bce-4be7-a5e1-1d9edb5a5001?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]!
Looking to connect with other AI enthusiasts? Join the Discord community: Learn AI Together [ https://substack.com/redirect/219d5e91-c2e7-431b-87e8-6a21767e1bc4?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]!
Want to share a product, event or course with my AI community? Reply directly to this email, or visit my Passionfroot profile [ https://substack.com/redirect/0e9b5051-c1a4-4bd3-9b77-f2722f043dd9?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] to see my offers.
Thank you for reading, and I wish you a fantastic week! Be sure to have enough sleep and physical activities next week!
Louis-François Bouchard
